lead: Private conversation, end-to-end encrypted: only you and the other person can read it. Not the Alumia team, not the server.
soMembros: Private messages are only for people who have joined Alumia (18 or older).

ativar.titulo: Turn on messages on this device
ativar.texto: We will create your key here, in the browser. It never leaves this device: it is what opens your conversations. On another device you turn it on again, and what was written before stays on this one only.
ativar.outroTitulo: Your messages are active on another device
ativar.outroTexto: If you turn them on here, this becomes your messaging device: conversations get a new key, and the other device stops opening what arrives from now on. What was already written stays readable only there.

nova.fechada: You cannot open a conversation with this person.

lista.vazio: No conversations yet. Open one with the person's @ or from their profile.
lista.pedidoEnviado: Request sent. Once the person accepts, you can both write.
lista.recusarExplica: Declining deletes the request, and the person cannot ask again for 30 days. They are not told.

conversa.semChave: Cannot be opened on this device (written before a device change).
conversa.semChaveDoOutro: The other person has not turned on messages yet. Once they do, you can write.
conversa.vazio: No messages. Reminder: never send an address, ID or password, not even here.
conversa.autoriaInvalida: This message's signature does not match.
conversa.mudou: {nome}'s security key changed. It may be a new device, or someone trying to pass as them. Confirm through another channel before going on.
conversa.apagarMensagemConfirma: Delete this message for both of you?
conversa.bloqueada: Conversation closed: there is a block between you.

acoes.prazoExplica: Shortening also applies to what was already written.
acoes.codigoExplica: Compare these numbers with the other person, in person or through a channel where you recognize each other. If they match, nobody is in the middle.
acoes.bloquearConfirma: Block this person? They will no longer be able to reach you, here or on Alumia.
acoes.apagarConfirma: Delete the whole conversation for both of you? This cannot be undone.

denuncia.explica: Tick the messages moderation will read. They are decrypted here, on your device, and only they are sent: moderation never has the conversation key. Whoever reports is never revealed.
denuncia.feito: Report received. Reference {protocolo}. Follow it in My reports.
denuncia.emergencia: In danger right now? In Brazil, call 190. Child or teenager at risk: dial 100.

ajustes.pedidos: Anyone on Alumia (people I don't follow back send a request)
ajustes.apagarTudoExplica: Deletes all your conversations (for both people in each one), your key and your settings. Your account stays. Brazil's LGPD, art. 18, VI.
ajustes.apagarTudoConfirma: Delete ALL your conversations and your messaging key? This cannot be undone.

erros.dm_fechada: You cannot message this person right now.
erros.dm_sem_chave: Missing key: the conversation cannot receive messages yet.
erros.versao_desatualizada: The conversation key changed. Try again.
erros.muitos_pedidos: Easy: too many messages in a row. Try again in a moment.
erros.consentimento: Private messages are only for people who have joined Alumia (18 or older).
erros.sem_indexeddb: This browser does not keep the key (private mode?). Messages work only while the tab stays open.
